verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a team inbox and collaboration product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable server edition of Missive. The evidence describes a vendor-hosted service: the API runs at public.missiveapp.com, and a community post notes that emails are fetched via Missive's servers. Custom MCP servers and IMAP connections to your own mail servers are integrations, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
